The root cause of the issue was a bug in the `next` function within `index.js`, where `activeCount` was being decremented by 0 (`activeCount -= 0`) instead of 1. This prevented the active task counter from ever decreasing, causing the concurrency limit to be reached quickly and subsequent queued tasks to stall indefinitely.

I have fixed this by changing `activeCount -= 0` to `activeCount--`.
